title_sq: Prane 21 Dhjetorit, Shitet Apartament 1+1 Ideal Per Investim!!
description_sq: Ne zonen e 21 Dhjetorit pas Komisariatit nr.2 shitet apartament 1+1 ideal per investim. Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e pare te nje pallati ekzistues. Ka siperfaqe neto 63.6m². Organizohet ne korridor, salloni i ndenjes me ballkon ku akseson ne nje oborr te vogel ne perdorim, ambienti i gatimit i vecuar, dhoma e gjumit dhe tualeti me dritare. Apartamenti shitet i pamobiluar. Zona ku ndodhet eshte mjaft e qete dhe me shume facilitete prane si kopshte, shkolla e shume sherbime te tjera. Shume opsion i mire dhe per investim duke qene qe zona ka kerkesa te larta per qira. Apartamenti diponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
title_en: Close to December 21, 1+1 Apartment for Sale, Ideal for Investment!!
description_en: In the area of ​​21 December, behind Police Station No. 2, a 1+1 apartment is for sale, ideal for investment. The apartment is located on the first floor of an existing building. It has a net area of ​​63.6m². It is organized in a corridor, a living room with a balcony with access to a small yard in use, a separate kitchen, a bedroom and a bathroom with a window. The apartment is sold unfurnished. The area where it is located is quite quiet and has many facilities nearby such as kindergartens, schools and many other services. Very good option for investment as the area has high demand for rent. The apartment has regular mortgage documentation.
